2.  **Around x = 150-160:** There is another distinct downward spike reaching nearly -4 mm, standing out against the background noise which is mostly between -2 and -3 mm in this region.
3.  **Around x = 570:** Towards the end of the series, there is a very prominent downward spike reaching almost -9 mm. This is clearly an outlier compared to the neighboring values which fluctuate around -5 to -6 mm.

These three locations represent significant anomalies in the data.
